case.title: Enumerator interview lasting 719 s fires

submissions.open_text: Hand pump handle broke last month and repairs took two weeks.
Prices from cart sellers doubled during the dry season.

case.why: 719 s is one second below the 720 s enumerator minimum, so too_fast must fire. Two wrong implementations would miss it. One converts to whole minutes with rounding (719/60 = 11.98, which rounds to 12 and so is 'not below 12'). The other compares against 12*60 with an off-by-one. Other checks are quiet: there are 2 submissions only. Both points are inside Kondele. The times are 14:05 and 10:20 local. The texts are distinct. There is no voice note, and the device is used by a single contributor.
